name: Daiwa Cycle Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daiwa Cycle Co.,Ltd. sells bicycles, and bicycles parts and accessories primarily in Japan. The company offers city, electric assist, children’s, girls, boys, kids, and mini cycles; sport and training bikes; and electric scooters. It also provides maintenance and repair services for bicycles. Daiwa Cycle Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.
